overall_goal: Clean up the kitchen, drink some juice, and prepare ingredients and utensils for the hibiscus drink.

goals.description: Rinse a plastic bottle and dry hands.
goals.rationale: The person rinses a plastic bottle in the sink, places it on the counter, and dries their hands with a napkin.

goals.description: Check and taste the boiling hibiscus drink.
goals.rationale: The person repeatedly adjusts the hob's heating, removes the saucepan lid to check the drink, and eventually tastes it before turning off the hob.
The person takes the electric kettle to the sink, fills it with water, and returns it to its dock on the counter.

goals.description: Wipe the counter and discard trash.
goals.rationale: The person wipes the counter surface, picks up a sticker and a freezer bags packet, and discards them in the bin and recyclables.
The person retrieves a mug from the draining rack, rinses it in the sink, and places it on the counter.
The person gets orange juice from the fridge, pours it into the mug, returns the juice to the fridge, and drinks from the mug.

goals.description: Search for a slotted spoon in the cupboards and drawers.
goals.rationale: The person opens and searches through various cupboards and a drawer looking for a slotted spoon.

goals.description: Organize the bag of sugar in the cupboard.
goals.rationale: The person retrieves a bag of sugar, places it in a resealable bag, and returns it to the cupboard.

goals.description: Set up the scale and measure sugar.
goals.rationale: The person retrieves and turns on a scale, places a lid on it, and pours sugar from a jar onto the lid to measure it.

goals.description: Retrieve and fill a measuring cup.
goals.rationale: The person takes a measuring cup out of a blender, inspects it, and fills it with water from the tap.

goals.description: Transfer the hibiscus drink and prepare utensils for mixing.
goals.rationale: The person pours the hibiscus drink into a Pyrex bowl, moves the bowl, and retrieves a tablespoon to mix the drink.
